# A dialog that never moved stays dimmed after a resize

## Context

Julia's defect-note (A2A, 2026-11-21 14:15Z, found while working on #21765) reports that cancelling a resize of a dialog that was never moved leaves it at `opacity: 0.3`. I reproduced it on `dev` at `44c18f271c`, and it is wider than the note: a committed resize does the same. The resize dims the dialog to 0.3 while its preview is drawn; afterwards a dialog that never moved stays at 30 % opacity until something moves it.

Two new tests in `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/MoveResize.spec.mjs`, run against `examples/dialog` on the unfixed engine (an Escape-cancelled resize, and a committed +150 px resize, each on a dialog that never moved), both fail the same way:

```
Error: the dialog is as opaque as before the gesture
Expected: "1"
Received: "0.3"
```

A regression from #21283 (#21280, merged 2026-11-18): before it, `Resizable#onDragEnd` wrote `opacity: 1`. That PR introduced `ownerOpacity` and restores it, deleting the key when the owner's style held none.

## The Problem

The existing cancel test (`MoveResize.spec.mjs:143`) moves the dialog first. `dialog.Base#onDragEnd` writes `opacity: 1` into its style, so `ownerOpacity` is 1 and the restore works. A dialog that never moved has no opacity in its style, which is the first thing a user does with a fresh dialog.

## The Architectural Reality

- `Resizable#onDragStart` (`src/plugin/Resizable.mjs:436-442`) keeps `ownerOpacity = style.opacity` (undefined for a dialog that never moved) and writes `style.opacity = 0.3`.
- `Resizable#closeGesture` (`src/plugin/Resizable.mjs:296-312`), called by `onDragEnd` and `onDragCancel`, deletes `style.opacity` when `ownerOpacity` is undefined, then re-assigns the style.
- `component.Base#style_` (`src/component/Base.mjs:270-283`) documents the single-node case: "to *remove* a style property you previously set, you MUST set it to `null`. Using `delete` or setting `undefined` will revert to the 'previous state'". A dialog is single-node (`vdom === vdomRoot`), so the deleted key keeps 0.3.

Design authority: `Resizable#ownerOpacity`'s JSDoc, "Both ends of the gesture, a cancel included, restore it."

## The Fix

In `closeGesture`, replace the delete branch with `style.opacity = me.ownerOpacity ?? null`. Add the two tests above to `MoveResize.spec.mjs`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: A resize of a dialog that never moved, committed or cancelled with Escape, leaves the dialog at the opacity it had before the gesture.
- [ ] AC-2: A moved dialog still passes the existing cancel test (`MoveResize.spec.mjs:143`).
- [ ] AC-3: Both new tests fail on the unfixed engine and pass with the fix, and `test/playwright/e2e/dialog/` passes.

## Out of Scope

- The dim value itself and the preview's 0.7 opacity.
- #21765, a cancelled touch that commits a drop.

## Related
